publisher: Shooting Illustrated (NRA), quoting the ATF NFA Handbook
title: Pinning a Muzzle Brake to Your Rifle
quote: Permanent methods of attachment include full-fusion gas or electric steel-seam welding, high-temperature (1,100 degrees Fahrenheit) silver soldering, or blind pinning with the pin head welded over.
note: Secondary quotation of the ATF NFA Handbook (atf.gov PDFs returned 403). Same passage: barrel length is measured from the closed bolt 'to the furthermost end of the barrel or permanently attached muzzle device'. Pin-and-weld is one of several accepted permanent methods (also full weld, high-temp silver solder).
